entities.name: PV+ posterior insula to pACC projections

relationships.subject: PV+ posterior insula to pACC projections
relationships.evidence_quote: Our results suggest the presence of inhibitory projections between the pIC and the pACC which are able to selectively modulate affective aspects of neuropathic pain.

key_findings: Small proportion of PV+ pIC neurons project to pACC; optogenetic stimulation did not change mechanical nociception but induced conditioned place preference in SNI mice.
